overview: Develvyn — The Family Suite is a multi-mode family and apartment management platform built on Internet Identity, covering Founder, Apartment, Family, and Watchman modes.
features: Internet Identity login with consent and recovery guidance flows
Role-based Mode Selector showing only assigned modes
Invite code system with 4 code types, expiry, revocation, and brute-force protection
Apartment canister with Founder approval flow, flat management, and role assignment
Canister-level role enforcement across all data access
Session timeouts with warnings per mode
Audit logging for all apartment actions
